concept.title: Pending approvals (proposal review)
concept.shortdesc: Agents with proposal write mode don't change your project directly — each write becomes a proposal. The Pending approvals counter at the top of the Runs page opens the review panel where you approve or reject each proposed artifact change, link, or test result. Only approved proposals are applied.

conbody.p: Each proposal is a card that reads as the change it makes:

ul.li: a chip naming the kind of write — New artifact, Edit, Delete, New link, Remove link or Test result;
the artifact it lands on, by reference and title (for a link, the two artifacts and the link type between them);
for an edit, each field it changes, with what the field says now struck through above what it would say; a new artifact lists the fields it sets, and a deletion shows what would go;
Raw payload, which opens the exact data the agent sent;
from its run, which opens the run that made the proposal beside the list.

conbody.p: Approve takes one press. Reject first asks why: a note field opens, and pressing Reject again rejects with whatever you wrote, or nothing. Add a note opens the same field for an approval. To decide several together, press Select several: each card gets a tick, and a bar offers Select all, one note and Approve Selected or Reject Selected.
